659 of Moje Village :- Naroda, Taluka Asarva, District Ahmedabad admeasuring about 0-94-09 (Hector-Are-Sq Mtrs); during pendency and till the final disposal of the present petition in the interest of justice."
2. As per the statement made in the Writ petition, the land in question was acquired in the year 1978 for the purpose of Sardarnagar Underground Drainage System, during the lifetime of the father of the petitioners, who had died on 04.05.2003.

The contention in the Writ petition is that the petitioners have recently came to know that the land of the petitioners was covered by fencing with iron wires by the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation and that it was acquired in the year 1978 for the purpose stated above.

3. It is further submitted that the petitioners came to know NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/2652/2025 ORDER DATED: 04/03/2025 undefined about the mutation entry dated 15.05.2000 with respect to the acquisition of the land in question made in the year 1978.

After inquiry into the revenue record, the petitioners also came to know that the Entry No. 19064 dated 17.08.2012 was made expunging the name of the father of the petitioners and the same was certified on 10.10.2012.

Having gained the knowledge of acquisition in the year 2023, the petitioners made application under the Right to Information Act seeking information about the proceedings of land acquisition and the award made, if any.

The contention is that the prayers made by the petitioners for re-grant of the land in question as there was no acquisition proceedings ever taken place and no compensation was paid to the petitioners, has not been addressed by the Collector inspite of representation dated 11.07.2023 made by the petitioners, hence the cause of action for filing the Writ petition arose.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
